sentence: This project studies how parts of a single neuron process incoming signals so the neuron can switch among different outputs.
This project tries to find out what the MRI signal means at the cellular level and builds tools to map tissue microstructure.
This project builds a sensor that quickly isolates and grows lymphocytes that target and kill cancer cells.
This project builds machine learning models that predict how proteins interact in immune receptors and how they recognize antigens.
This project provides mass spectrometry and data analysis tools to study proteins and molecular mechanisms of diabetes.
This project uses conductive polymers to electrically control stem cells and find pathways that help the brain recover from stroke.
This project uses neuroimaging to measure how brain circuitry and brain metabolism change with alcohol, stress, or both.
This project studies what keeps a group of T cell progenitors going in allergic tissues, using human and animal models.
This project brings together researchers and clinicians to promote understanding of visual system development and disease.
This project uses digital health to improve access to evidence-based interventions for alcohol misuse in adolescents.
This project uses machine learning to find risk factors for cardiopulmonary and renal end organ complications in people with sickle cell disease.
This project builds a glycan sequencing platform to study the glycome in health and disease.
This project studies how a phosphatase and two kinases work together in a signaling pathway that acute myeloid leukemia depends on.
This project uses machine learning on satellite imagery and other geotagged data to measure maternal and child health in low- and middle-income countries.
This project builds computer models to understand how aortic disease progresses in mouse models.
This project tests whether blocking a pathway in transplanted human stem cell-derived neurons helps them survive and connect in the eye.
This project studies the identity and diversity of somatosensory neurons in larval Aedes aegypti.
This project provides statistical and bioinformatics services to help study how bladder cancer develops and how it might be treated.
This project characterizes extracellular glycoproteins and studies what they do.
This project studies how combinations of cell signals drive human primordial germ cell differentiation, using experiments and computational modeling.
